## Background

I was born in Montreal and currently live in Vancouver, British Columbia. I completed a Bachelor of Commerce at UBC Sauder, specializing in Marketing and Business Technology Management with a minor in International Business. Before starting MDS, I worked as a marketing manager in Richmond.

## Why data science

My professional experience showed me the importance of using data to understand customers and make informed marketing decisions. I joined the UBC Master of Data Science program to strengthen my technical and analytical skills and apply data science to marketing analytics.

## Outside data science

In my free time, I enjoy reading manga and manhwa and playing sports, mostly rugby.
